**Issue #4969 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4969: Patch: leave e2e off in ci-scope for crates/tools/perf-corpus
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When any pull request or maintenance job touches the performance regression records in `crates/tools/perf-corpus/` (introduced in PR #4924 / #4958), CI runs the full 4-shard Cypress E2E smoke suite unnecessarily because `scripts/ci-scope.sh` was not updated to skip `e2e` for changes in that directory.

## Why
In `scripts/ci-scope.sh`, line 414 explicitly allows changes to tools sources and the fuzz corpus to leave `e2e` off:
```sh
crates/tools/src/* | crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/*) ;;
```
The header comment in `scripts/ci-scope.sh` (lines 169–170) explains:
"and the fuzz's records (crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/), so a change to the fuzz, the classifier or another command leaves e2e off. That is safe: `replay`'s shipped code names no other module of the crate... and the push to `main` runs e2e smoke after the merge (#3564)."

PR #4924 added `crates/tools/perf-corpus/` with 52 pinned regression records. However, `crates/tools/perf-corpus/*` was not added to the pattern on line 414 alongside `fuzz-corpus/*`. As a result, changes to `perf-corpus/*.json` fall into the default arm `*) on e2e ;;` on line 415, triggering all 4 shards of `e2e smoke` (~1–2 minutes per shard on a 4-core runner) even though no e2e spec reads or depends on `perf-corpus/`.

## Proposal
1. In `scripts/ci-scope.sh` (line 414), expand the ignore pattern to include `crates/tools/perf-corpus/*`:
```sh
crates/tools/src/* | crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/* | crates/tools/perf-corpus/*) ;;
```
2. Update the explanatory comment in `scripts/ci-scope.sh` (line 169) to mention `crates/tools/perf-corpus/`.
3. In `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` (around line 531), add a unit test asserting that `onFor("crates/tools/perf-corpus/plain-1-v0.6.14.json")` returns `["full", "rust_tools_wasm"]` and does not include `e2e`, mirroring the existing test for `crates/tools/fuzz-corpus/seed-8-v0.4.12d.json`.

## Where it lands
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh:169`
- `scripts/ci-scope.sh:414`
- `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts:531`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Changes solely under `crates/tools/perf-corpus/` produce `e2e=false` and `rust_tools_wasm=true` in `scripts/ci-scope.sh`.
- [ ] `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` asserts `onFor("crates/tools/perf-corpus/plain-1-v0.6.14.json")` equals `["full", "rust_tools_wasm"]`.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts` passes.

## Size and risks
Small. A one-line pattern addition in `scripts/ci-scope.sh` and one test case in `apps/web/src/net/ci-scope.test.ts`. Zero runtime risk; saves substantial CI runner time when pinning or updating perf corpus seeds.
````
